core_obligations: The pushforward (proof lines 5075-5087): the author displays a chain of equalities identifying the pushforward with the direct image along the right adjoint, each equality attributed to a named result or to the definition.
The pullback (proof lines 5088-5093): a similar chain identifies the pullback with the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the right adjoint, using two named results.
proof_roadmap: Identify the pushforward with the direct image along the right adjoint by a chain of attributed equalities.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a cocontinuous functor together with a right adjoint, the pushforward of the associated morphism of topoi is the direct image along the right adjoint and the pullback is the sheafification of the associated functor on presheaves (statement lines 5055-5072). The proof is a complete computation: the author displays a chain of equalities identifying the pushforward, attributing each step to a named result or to the definition (proof lines 5075-5087), and a second chain for the pullback (proof lines 5088-5093). The non-formal content is the assembly of the identifications. The claim is H1: two written-out chains with every step attributed.
